HARD_FIX P1 1/6: entitlements.py diff is per-target (keyed by .entitlements/Info.plist path) and compares values, not just key sets, so a permission flipped true→false on one target shows as a changed entry instead of no-op
HARD_FIX P1 2/6: cli.py ui_tap now has its own subparser with --x/--y/--selector, forwarded into metavr_bridge.wrap's argv; missing both is a usage error (exit 2), not a no-target tap
HARD_FIX P1 3/6: xcodebuild_receipt.py status is "failed" if any ** TEST/BUILD FAILED ** banner appears anywhere in the log, so a later SUCCEEDED summary banner cannot hide an earlier failure
HARD_FIX P1 4/6: cli.py main() maps status "unverified" (no result banner found) to exit code 1, not 0

HARD_FIX P1 5/6: snapshot_diff.py compares single --before/--after files by content hash directly (_diff_single); basenames are no longer used as dict keys, so before.png vs after.png no longer reports as one file added plus one removed

HARD_FIX P1 6/6: plist_lint.py USAGE_KEYS now also covers NSContactsUsageDescription, NSCalendarsUsageDescription, NSRemindersUsageDescription, NSMotionUsageDescription, NSHealthShareUsageDescription, NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription, NSHealthClinicalHealthRecordsShareUsageDescription, NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription, NSSiriUsageDescription, NSHomeKitUsageDescription, NSAppleMusicUsageDescription, NSVideoSubscriberAccountUsageDescription, NSNearbyInteractionUsageDescription, NSSensorKitUsageDescription, and NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription; a blank value on any of these keys now fails lint the same way NSCameraUsageDescription already did
P2: xcodebuild_receipt.py DEST_RE now captures a quoted -destination value (e.g. "platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16") in full instead of truncating at the first internal space
P2: metavr_bridge.wrap only reports status "recorded" when the subprocess exits 0 AND the --out path actually exists on disk; exit 0 with a missing artifact is now "failed" with output_written: false
